decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 228.94 EUR for one charge. Card CRD-000197 shows two purchases at LARKSPUR APPAREL (MER-000015) for the same amount: TXN-008180 for 228.94 EUR at 2026-09-01T18:36:44Z and TXN-008181 for 228.94 EUR at 2026-09-01T18:41:44Z. Both posted on 2026-09-02. Both carry the same authorisation, AUTH-008363, which was approved for 228.94 EUR. So one authorisation was posted twice. No refund appears for either charge. The dispute was opened 51 days after posting, inside the 120-day time limit. Under duplicate-same-authorisation, only the extra charge (TXN-008181) is credited. 228.94 EUR is below the 3,000 EUR limit for provisional credit. The cardholder asked for both charges back (457.88 EUR). That does not change the credit: the first charge matches an approved, 3-D Secure authenticated purchase the cardholder says they made, so only one charge is in dispute.
